model.name: Task 23.2: YouTube URLs render as embedded iframe player
model.description: When a YouTube URL is discovered in a room (dropped as text/uri-list or pasted in chat), the preview automatically renders it as an embedded YouTube iframe player by extracting the video ID and rendering https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id> instead of plain text.
model.intention: Tron: "when a YouTube URL is discovered in the room... automatically render it as an EMBEDDED YouTube iframe player in the preview — extract the video ID from the URL, render as youtube.com/embed/<id>." (Heartspaces room: youtube.com/watch?v=a-_CuBOu6BA shows as text, not embedded.)
model.context: Room content preview pane (ContentPreviewer / rb-preview-pane, R21.9). A YouTube .url in the Heartspaces room renders as text; this adds detection + iframe embed.
